text:
Alex Chung: Quick async check — Rack set B (reservation 4B-2026) is queued but I'm seeing no cable-kit signal in the manifest. Who's owning procurement handoff for that wave? We need confirmation before we greenlight onboarding.

Priya Mehta: @Alex I own the order side. Procurement placed the chassis + PSUs yesterday, cable kits were delayed by vendor. ETA from supplier is 'EOW' but I pushed for earlier. I'll confirm by EOD and update the manifest.

Manuel Ruiz: FYI infra side: power mapping and PDUs for Rack B are validated. Just blocked on the network patch panel arrival to do final labeling. If cable kits arrive late we can stage servers but not finish cross-rack L2 tests.

Jordan Lee: Reservation 4B-2026 is allocated in the scheduler, but note we only have 8/12 nodes flagged for dedicated. Need the remaining 4 before we switch routing policies. Who's owning the node commissioning? @Manuel?

Manuel Ruiz: Yep I'll run commissioning once cables + patch panels are in. Plan: racking -> power -> network -> node bootstrap. Expect ~2 hours per rack once everything present.

Liz Park: Quick code review ping — I opened #485 on infra-playbooks with the updated canary checklist for Rack B (adds cable-kit presence -> smoke gating). Link: https://git.redwood/infra-playbooks/pulls/485 Please review, it's blocking automation. :eyes:

procurement-bot: Order 2026-1145 (cable-kits, vendor: CableCo) status: shipped -> carrier AWB 1Z9999. Estimated delivery: 2026-03-20 16:30 UTC. Tracking: https://carrier.example/1Z9999

Priya Mehta: Thanks @procurement-bot — I created a manifest entry and added the AWB. Updated owners: procurement (me), infra (Manuel), oncall (Jordan). I'll escalate if ETA shifts.

Alex Chung: If shipment is on schedule we can keep the noon handoff tomorrow. If delayed past 18:00 UTC we should reschedule onboarding to Thursday to avoid weekend smoke tests. Can we add a fallback lane to spin up 4 spare nodes in staging in case of last-minute shortage?

Jordan Lee: Technically yes — staging has capacity for a 4-node mimicked slice. I can provision temporary endpoints and update routing. Need PR to allow partial capacity rollouts (Liz, that's the playbook change).

Liz Park: I'll add the partial-rollout steps to PR #485 — includes canary traffic split 20/80 and automatic rollback on error >0.5% over 10m. Also adding a small snippet for `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain` for quick rollback: 

```
kubectl cordon node-023
kubectl drain node-023 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

Manuel Ruiz: Heads up — ops-bot will run preflight tomorrow 06:30 UTC. ops-bot: can you include a check for AWB presence in the manifest and fail if absent?

ops-bot: Preflight job queued for 2026-03-19 06:30 UTC. Checks: power-mapping, pdu-health, network-patch, AWB-tracking. AWB check will be performed against manifest field `logistics.shipments`.

Alex Chung: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Priya — ping when AWB shows 'delivered' and we'll lock the noon slot. If not delivered, reschedule + notify customers. :thumbsup:
